content: Start a new game with the goguryeo-391 seed

The year is 391 CE. Spring. You are 고담덕 — the new king of Goguryeo. Seventeen years old. Your father 고국양왕 died last month, and you have just been enthroned in the fortress capital of 국내성 (Gungnae Seong), on the middle Yalu. The court watches. The generals wait. To the south, Baekje under King Asin grows bolder each season. To the west, the Xianbei state of Later Yan eyes the Yalu basin. To the southeast, Silla's King Naemul watches for a chance to break Baekje's dominance. The treasury is thin, the army ready, the throne still warm. What is your first move?
I want to inspect the treasury, the southern border defenses, and the diplomatic state with Silla.

state.truncated_summary: faction_goguryeo.resources: {gold: 800, food: 2200, iron: 400}. province_han_basin.controller_id: faction_baekje. diplomatic_relations with faction_silla: +30 (cordial).

content: Your treasurer reports 800 gold in the treasury — enough for one season of upkeep (military alone: ~375-750 gold). The southern border along the Yalu basin is held by province_yalu_frontier, currently the only Goguryeo territory south of Gungnae, garrisoned by 5,000 men under a general whose name history has not preserved. South of that, the Han River basin is Baekje's — and Baekje's Asin is unlikely to wait forever. Silla's Naemul, you hear, has been sending cautious overtures through the Buddhist monks of the recently-built Pyongyang temples. He fears Baekje; he has not yet decided whether you are a partner or a rival.
Send an envoy to Silla with gifts — propose a defensive alliance. We will share intelligence on Baekje and coordinate our southern defense.

event.reason: Founding action: open diplomatic channel with Silla, propose defensive alliance.

content: The envoy departs with gifts of gold and iron, carrying your proposal. The monks of Pyongyang will bless the journey. Silla's reply will arrive in the autumn — they will not refuse, but they will negotiate. The turn passes into summer. The court murmurs. The southern border holds. This is the start of something — or the first move in a longer game. End of turn 0.
